summary: The current-source app-only Calculator capture produced a valid participant thumbnail, but the large local own-screen viewer stayed black after returning to BOOHTACORD. The defect is in the local viewer/render path or its interaction with app-task capture; root cause is not yet proven.

checks.name: Installed application revision
checks.observation: The initial installed package was versionName 1.0.18, versionCode 2023, and its picker still displayed Android capture guidance removed from current source in commit 0838dc6. A current-source APK was built as versionName 1.0.18, versionCode 2024; the signer matched the installed package and Android accepted an in-place update without deleting app data. The updated picker no longer displayed that guidance.

checks.name: App-only capture target and local preview
checks.command: adb shell dumpsys media_projection; adb exec-out screencap -p
checks.observation: On versionCode 2024, Android reported RECORD_CONTENT_TASK targeting com.google.android.calculator. After returning to BOOHTACORD, the main local viewer remained black after approximately 21 seconds, while the participant card displayed a Calculator thumbnail. Thumbnail freshness was not independently verified during that interval, so this proves app-task pixels reached the thumbnail capture path but does not establish ongoing capture or explain the black VideoTrackRenderer. The room UI showed microphone muted and RTT around 7 ms.

checks.name: Stop and cleanup
checks.command: Stop share and leave voice; adb shell dumpsys media_projection
checks.observation: Screen share was stopped, the voice session was left, and MediaProjection reported no active projection.

limitations: The Android texture renderer's frame callbacks/EGL presentation were not instrumented; no conclusion can yet be drawn about whether frames reached the renderer or were presented.
No remote macOS or web receiver was connected; remote playback and receiver frame metrics were not tested.
The user-reported full-display success was not repeated in this authorized app-only test.
remaining: Reproduce with a paired macOS or web receiver, inspect bounded local sender/receiver frame stats, and identify why the Android local VideoTrackRenderer is black while thumbnail capture has pixels. Add a regression test and fix before closing T-030 preview acceptance.
